study.question: Does direct supervision of each orientation reduce the reversal-invariant predictor penalty, or does the supplied-order advantage persist after controlling the probability-mixture objective?
study.hypothesis: Observed single-seed validation: reversal_average AUC0.6661558656562611 versus supplied_duplicate0.6684446392075064 at identical32192421 parameters; both cost about584-597s. A separately trained deterministic supplied_reverse reached0.6683840768721943, so reversal alone retains usable information. Convexity makes BCE of the probability average no greater than mean per-view BCE for unclipped probabilities. It may permit compensating errors from individually weak orientations under the frozen single pass. Supervising each view may improve the reversal-average predictor without changing reversal invariance, learned capacity or inference cost. This is provisional optimization reasoning, not an established order-information mechanism.

All complete-event transport, joint2B Dice population and probability averaging from g1-r0063-reversal_average

study.proposed_difference: A2x2 factorial: reversal/supplied pair crossed with mean/per_view supervision. Per_view loss is0.5 times the sum of per-task BCE means for each view; mean loss supervises the returned probability average. Forward still returns four B-row averages. A transient training-forward graph cache is consumed/cleared by training_loss and cleared by eval forward; no labels enter forward. Both losses execute in all cells with FP32 BCE and clipping1e-7, including zero-gradient backward paths. Identical supplied views make the objective contrast an algebraic null away from clipping/roundoff. No learned parameters are added. This enforces reversal symmetry only, not arbitrary permutation invariance. Host preflight must verify mean-hook agreement with default BCE before historical bridge interpretation.
predictions: reversal_per_view improves click AUC over reversal_mean_bridge if mixture supervision materially limits this one-pass fit. Predeclared practical improvement: at least0.0005 AUC; one seed cannot establish significance.

The interaction (reversal_per_view - reversal_mean_bridge) - (supplied_per_view - supplied_mean_bridge) is positive. The supplied objective-null contrast should be within1e-5 AUC; report raw outcomes if that tolerance fails.

All cells retain32192421 parameters:31793216 embedding and399205 dense. Equal external data passes and two-view inference are shared; actual wall/GPU time, memory, throughput and latency must be measured.

At fixed eval parameters, reversing valid events and aligned eligibility swaps the two reversal views, preserving all task predictions within native numerical tolerance. The per-view objective is also reversal symmetric.
Fresh mean bridges should reproduce their matching g1-r0063 receipts within measured numerical variation. Diagnose unexplained drift before objective attribution.
falsifiers: A nonpositive reversal objective effect, or an effect no larger than the supplied-null change, fails to support this mixture-objective explanation under the frozen recipe.
A persistent reversal-versus-supplied deficit with per-view supervision supports robustness to this objective replacement only; it does not prove all order-invariant models inferior.
Cache/label misalignment, invalid-event leakage, broken mask transport, changed target, symmetry failure, parameter mismatch or illicit state mutation invalidates the experiment.
Large supplied-null or mean-bridge drift requires investigating precision, clipping, host BCE semantics and optimization before mechanism claims.
Any recovery remains preliminary until repeated with paired seeds. No held-out outcome may guide changes.
alternative_explanations: Supplied orientation can carry predictive information that reversal invariance removes.
Finite-pass optimization, mixed-view Dice statistics, clipping/saturation and reduction arithmetic can alter trajectories. The controls address some but not all of these.
Per-view BCE adds consistency pressure and changes loss curvature; improvement would not isolate compensating branch errors as the sole explanation.

Prior lexical, hash, ring, dihedral and canonical-path candidates were unsuccessful locally. g1-r0056-supplied_local_duplicate also lost utility, while g1-r0059-coefficient_rotation_transport recovered most rotated-basis loss. Representation and optimization therefore remain alternatives to an information-only explanation. These are multiple mechanism trajectories, not independent repetitions.

The empty-history reversal_average AUC0.5870066038495925 versus duplicate0.5878296037884854 suggests global training effects can occur even without sequence content; report this slice without claiming its small difference significant.
One seed, temporal shift, exploratory validation reuse, and inherited official_offline feedback maturity limit transfer. No timestamp, time-gap or production-causal claim is possible.
